description: Hand-authored expected outputs for simple propagation cases. Computed by hand from the documented v1 rules BEFORE running the engine; exact-match assertions.

case_single_edge.setup: cap_t (target 0.99, floor 0.5) -requires(w=0.8, cf=1.0, lag_median=5)-> node_a (recovery 30m). Incident: node_a unavailable, severity 0.5, duration 60m. Horizon 120m, step 5m.
case_single_edge.hand_math: node_a = 0.5 during [0,60], then linear decay over 30m. cap(t) = 0.8 * node_a(t-5).

case_full_substitute.setup: Same graph plus node_b substitute (substitutability 1.0, healthy) declared on the edge.

case_action_damping.setup: Single-edge case plus action (capacity_effect 0.5, duration 0) on node_a scheduled at t=0.
